Knueppel will miss a third straight outing due to a left hamstring strain, with his next chance to play coming Wednesday at Detroit. The second-year swingman's continued absence will leave additional playing time available for the likes of Sion James and Grayson Allen.

Williams will miss each of the Hornets' first three games of the regular season due to a right hamstring strain that popped up during training camp in late September. Marshall is under the weather and will be held out of Monday's road game, and his next chance to suit up will come when the Mavericks host the Thunder on Wednesday. With the 28-year-old forward unavailable, Zaccharie Risacher and Marcus Sasser could see increased burn.

Bassey has been dealing with a right knee issue for some time, but he is likely to make a second straight appearance. The big man played well during Saturday's loss to the Suns, logging 10 points (4-4 FG, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and two blocks in just 13 minutes.

McConnell has yet to make his season debut for the Pacers as he tries to work his way back from a hamstring strain. His next chance to make his season debut will be in the second leg of this back-to-back set Monday at Milwaukee.
Edey will sit out the front end of this back-to-back set. With the big man unavailable, Isaiah Stewart and Quinten Post are candidates to see increased playing time.
